summary: Specifies how to set up secure connection-oriented media sessions over TLS using SDP. It defines a TCP/TLS protocol identifier and a fingerprint attribute that identifies the certificate to be used. It was standards-track and has been replaced by RFC 8122.

eli5.summary: Two people set up a call and agree beforehand how to check each other's ID, using a short fingerprint of the ID, then talk through a locked tunnel.
